name: Half Roll Back
summary: Sitting tall with knees bent, curl the tail under and roll back halfway, then return. Builds the control needed for the Roll Up.
steps: Sit tall, knees bent, feet flat, hands behind the thighs or reaching forward.
Breathe out to tuck the tail and roll back until the lower back is close to the mat.
Breathe in to hold the curve.
Breathe out to curl forward and stack back up to sitting.

layers.title: Hold and add arms
layers.text: Stay back and lift the arms or pulse.

layers.title: Prop
layers.text: Ball between the knees or behind the lower back.

cues:
Start the roll from the pelvis, not by slumping the chest.
Feet stay heavy.
Shoulders stay over the ribs — don't lean back flat.
